d: Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff has launched a fierce attack on President Donald Trump, accusing his administration of misleading Americans into another Middle East war. Speaking at a get-out-the-vote rally in Georgia, Ossoff questioned the US war's objectives, saying Iran still has drones, missiles and uranium despite claims of military success. He cited 21 American deaths, hundreds wounded and record-high diesel prices, arguing that the conflict is hurting families and farmers.
